title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00005 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 02:45: Continued to bleed off tubing pressure to 0 bar. Slow progress due to unable to use PWV for bleed off.
02:45 - 03:00: Closed HMV. Broke lubricator and l/d dummy BHA.
03:00 - 03:35: L/d lubricator and GIH on catwalk using rig crane and top drive.
03:35 - 04:00: Connected lifting sub to middle riser section.
04:00 - 04:15: Disconnected lower riser from XMT. Lifted entire riser section and BOP from XMT up to moonpool area.
04:15 - 04:20: Installed top cap on XMT.
04:20 - 04:55: Tested KWV cap and top cap to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min.
04:55 - 06:00: Replaced WL hatch with permanent hatch. Handed well back to production. end of operation
